description: This file implements various scheduler metrics consumers for logging and output, including functions for printing scheduler headers, converting events to strings, and handling metrics reports for cells and UEs in a network scheduler context.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics_consumer_stdout
classes.description: Handles outputting scheduler metrics to stdout.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics_consumer_e2
classes.description: Handles reporting scheduler metrics via notifier.

methods.name: print_sched_header
methods.description: Prints the header for scheduler metrics output.

methods.name: event_to_string
methods.description: Converts scheduler cell event types to string representations.

methods.name: handle_metric
methods.description: Processes scheduler metrics report and outputs or logs metrics for cells and UEs.
